title: Signed Clean
premise: The wrecked train's maintenance ledger says its brakes and couplers were inspected and sound. The wreck says otherwise, and the inspector who signed was dead before the dates he signed for.

places.name: The wreck on the Tellico road
places.what: Where the ledger, the journal, the brake shoes and the draw-bar are

places.name: Mercy Crossing
places.what: Pike, Vane, Pritchard, the notice board, the stove

stages.set_by: The player has the maintenance ledger
stages.log: The train's maintenance ledger says the brakes and couplers were inspected and sound.

stages.set_by: The player examines the brake shoes
The player has the marshal's journal
The player looks at Ada Pike's parts book
The ledger and one piece of evidence (the quest's script)
stages.log: The ledger and the wreck don't agree.
Whoever kept this ledger wrote down work that was never done.

stages.set_by: Posted on the notice board, no name

objectives.text: Compare the ledger to the wreck
Decide what to do with the evidence

options.label: Report it to Pritchard
options.now: He takes copies and sends word up the line
options.later: The Iron Junction yard has been warned

options.label: Post the pages
options.now: The town reads them; nobody is accused
options.later: The matter is public and nobody owns it

ways_through: Take the ledger and any one piece of evidence, then decide
Never touch it: the side quest stays hidden and the main quest is not held up
cannot_break: Evidence counts in any order, before or after the ledger. One outcome, ever. If Haskell is dead the pages go up with no name.
open_questions: The full design is docs/design/TLM_SQ01_signed-clean.md; this file only shows the format.
